claims.claim: A hook denial or chunk-hook abort becomes *ValidationError; a provider HTTP or transport failure becomes *ProviderError; other errors unchanged
ValidatorType is the validator_type metadata, else the hook type; a stream abort reports provider_chunk
ProviderError Provider falls back to the conversation's provider ID; StatusCode set only for HTTP errors; Cause holds the runtime error
Send, Stream, Resume and Continue apply the wrapping
PackError returned by Open, OpenDuplex, OpenWorkflow, OpenMultiAgent, ValidatePack and Evaluate; errors.Is(ErrPackNotFound) still matches
ToolError names the tool; the model receives a ToolError's Cause text alone
